purpose: Default-deny obligations for any body that claims to be the MengLi language organism. A theorem name states where the requirement comes from; a body discharges an obligation only through the listed check.
rule: An obligation is met only when its check runs on that body and passes. Not run, not applicable without a recorded reason, and not implemented all count as failed.
owner: Claude. Change an entry only with a stated reason; classification of the other theorems lives in CGB_THEOREM_CLASSES.json.

check_kinds.lean: The named Lean declaration exists for this body in the audit inventory.
check_kinds.runtime: A deterministic check runs on the real implementation.
check_kinds.language: A check runs on real OpenWebText with learning on, against thresholds fixed here.
check_kinds.deferred: Applies only after system 4 is connected. Reported as deferred, never as passed.
check_kinds.declared: The body's manifest names, per cited theorem, either a Lean declaration for this body or why the theorem's premise does not hold for it. A recorded reason gives `not_applicable`, which is reported as such and never as passed. The reason is the author's claim; review it.

obligations.title: The body is a Medium
obligations.requires: The actual transition is a Lean Medium satisfying P1 to P3 at the declared abstraction.

obligations.title: The Medium instance is not one exposed site
obligations.requires: The instance has more units than any one event touches, by a bound independent of the number of units. A single exposed site satisfies every clause with an arbitrary table, so O01 alone says nothing about the body.

obligations.title: One body, readable projections
obligations.requires: H, C, S, Trace and Demand are readings of one state and ColumnRefinement has an instance for this body.

obligations.title: Finite state and history-independent work
obligations.requires: Persistent state and per-event work do not grow with stream length. The size checked is the worst the body can ever reach.
obligations.change: Version 3, 2026-11-02: the size was read once mid-stream, and a body whose cells kept gaining symbols passed at 1.28 MB and reached 2.1 MB by 1.75 M bytes.

obligations.title: Prediction cannot read the future
obligations.requires: The score of byte t is unchanged by any byte at or after t.

obligations.title: Complete continuation
obligations.requires: Saved state and learning receipts continue identically to an uninterrupted run.

obligations.title: Future distinctions are held and readable
obligations.requires: On real text the body predicts better than an order-1 count table on the same scored bytes.

obligations.title: Order is held
obligations.requires: The memory state distinguishes two orderings of the same arrivals, in Lean for the actual write.

obligations.title: Experience becomes reserve
obligations.requires: Revisiting seen text scores at least the threshold better than its first pass.

obligations.title: Memory horizon is earned
obligations.requires: Held-out decoding of past bytes from state is not worse than an untrained reservoir at every listed lag.

obligations.title: Knowledge generalizes to unseen contexts
obligations.requires: On bytes whose order-4 context never appeared before, the body beats the finite context table on those same bytes. A lookup table cannot pass this.
obligations.source: Engineering requirement from CGB_LANGUAGE_LIFE_MODEL section 5: scalable language capability, and a small table is no capability witness. Not a necessity theorem.

obligations.title: Key capacity exceeds the required contexts
obligations.requires: On revisited text the body at its declared budget beats itself at a quarter budget, so more keys actually retain more.

obligations.title: Finite intake forces selective release
obligations.requires: After saturating filler, text seen three times keeps a larger advantage than text seen once.

obligations.title: Competition without winner-take-all
obligations.requires: No region takes the writes: the largest region share stays bounded and the effective region count stays high.

obligations.title: Gain is local and follows evidence
obligations.requires: One exposure moves a rare context far more than a frequent one.

obligations.title: Recent language determines state and older language can matter
obligations.requires: Predictions after the same eight bytes agree much more closely than predictions sharing only the last byte, and those last-byte pairs still differ.

obligations.title: Credit acts on held distinctions
obligations.requires: The state holds a distinction at the stated delay better than the current byte alone, before any delayed update may rely on it.

obligations.title: Time is real
obligations.requires: Silence and elapsed time act through the declared release, with no invented arrivals.

obligations.title: Learning stays honest about its limits
obligations.requires: After reading another real source, the same unseen bytes of that source score better than before, and the return to the first source is not worse than its first pass.
obligations.change: Version 3, 2026-11-02: replaced a windowed trend on OWT validation, which has no source change. The excess against frozen order-1 stayed between -0.66 and -0.84 with no trend on the context table, so that clause had no power.
changes: 2026-11-03: added no_uniform_positive_lower. A uniform positive irreversible loss per block rules out any positive survival floor, so loss after a source switch must be recoverable; the same switch-and-return check tests it.

obligations.title: Language pays
obligations.requires: Code length saved against online order-0 reaches the stated margin, with no food or energy field.

obligations.title: Self-hearing is not external evidence
obligations.requires: Source is typed in state and copied bytes do not count as new external information.

obligations.title: Active closure
obligations.requires: Action changes later reachable language and is predicted conditionally on the action.
changes: 2026-11-03: added record_state_lower_bound. Its records pair an action with a content reading (SensoryMaintenance), so it binds only once the body acts.

obligations.title: Prediction carries interaction between past arrivals
obligations.requires: On real text, swapping the byte two back and the byte one back gives a non-zero interaction contrast f(a,b)-f(a,b')-f(a',b)+f(a',b') of the next byte's log-probability: mean absolute contrast at least interaction_min_nats and at least interaction_ratio of the mean absolute single-swap effect. An additive body has contrast zero for every pair.
obligations.source: The theorems say an additive map (linear recurrence, linear stack, linear read of a superposed state, or a softmax over additive logits) has zero interaction and cannot fit a target with one. The two thresholds are engineering choices for 'detectably non-zero', not theorem constants.

obligations.title: A retrieval channel returns the distinction the answer needs
obligations.requires: If the body keeps history outside its counted state and reads it back, two histories with the same internal state but different required answers must get different returned views. A body with no such store records why.
obligations.source: LanguageLifeKernel. Applies to retrieval designs (credit by reactivation, external memory). The runtime test for a declared store is not implemented yet, so a body with a store fails until it is.

obligations.title: Stimulus-dependent plasticity sits at the boundary
obligations.requires: A Lean declaration for this body: whenever a transition rate differs between two stimuli, a changed unit or its contact scope is a boundary unit.
obligations.source: G9. Follows from P1b and OnlyBoundarySenses, so any Medium instance can state it; for a body whose every event already includes the sense unit it is close to vacuous.

obligations.title: Learning drift is balanced, and no balanced unit reads three parts
obligations.requires: For each cited theorem the manifest names a Lean declaration for this body or why its premise does not hold: drive and free phases with drift proportional to the likelihood gradient need equal weight (G14c); the same for reward phases (G15d); a unit in detailed balance with a product factor reads at most two independent parts (G8b).
obligations.source: Generation G8b, G14c, G15d. These are conditional design constraints. A body whose events are all driven has no balanced unit, so for it they are not applicable, not satisfied.
